data.name: Dhanjee
data.gender_notes: Dhanjee is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Dhanjee is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘dhan’ which means wealth and ‘jee’ meaning god. It signifies that the person named Dhanjee is blessed with God's wealth and prosperity in their life. The name Dhanjee carries the meaning “God's wealth, prosperity” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Dhanjee usually hope their child will grow to embody god's wealth, prosperity and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Blessed with divine abundance and prosperity
data.etymology: Dhanjee belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's wealth, prosperity.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dhanjee total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
